## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. Please also include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code quality style guidelines of this project (PEP 8, Ruff clean).
- [ ] I have added full type annotations and public docstrings to all new classes and methods.
- [ ] I have added unit tests that cover my changes.
- [ ] All new and existing unit tests pass successfully.
- [ ] My changes do not introduce any new static analysis warnings (Ruff, MyPy, Bandit).
